days.title: Forests and Moor Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Diverzand
stops.detail: Larger fir forests can be found around the Berkenheuvel estate and in the Diverzand.

stops.name: Snoekveen
stops.detail: In the forests there are numerous small moor lakes and clearings with heath landscapes, for example Snoekveen and Grote Veen.

days.title: Southwest Heathlands and Streams
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Doldersummerveld
stops.detail: A vast heath field is located in the southwest of the park, the Doldersummerveld and the Wasperveld, which is particularly suitable for bird watching (curlew, stonechat, hen harrier) and has one of the two existing observation towers.

stops.name: De Vledder Aa
stops.detail: The upper reaches of the De Vledder Aa stream are located here.

days.title: Sand Dunes and Visitor Hubs
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Aekingerzand
stops.detail: Aekingerzand is the largest drift sand area.

stops.name: Grenspoel
stops.detail: The woodlark and the wheatear also occur here, and at the Grenspoel and on the Berkenheuvel estate there are chances to observe hawks and black woodpeckers.

stops.name: Oude Willem
stops.detail: In the middle of the national park is Oude Willem, an extensive agricultural area whose cultivation is controlled by the nature conservation administration.

stops.name: Besucherzentrum in Appelscha
stops.detail: The national park has a visitor center in Appelscha and Diever as well as information boards at the park's six large parking lots.
